About this item

  • PLATFORM SOLE - It's the best selling Club C - elevated! We took trendy platform women's shoes and merged them into cute chunky sneakers that are great travel, work or casual walking shoes.
  • ALL DAY COMFORT - These aren't your average white sneakers for women. A hip platform is added to an iconic classic Reebok style to give you extra height and style. They have a durable rubber outsole and a padded terry tongue and collar.
  • DURABLE LEATHER UPPER - Grab the Club C Double womens sneakers when you need a pair of comfortable white tennis shoes - or just to make a fashion statement. Perforated details make them breathable, and tonal leather overlays elevate the design.
  • VERSATILE COLORS - Our iconic Club C Double sneaker collection goes the extra mile by offering women footwear options for everyday life. This is the shoe that goes with everything, and it's classic and trendy at the same time. Lace up closure.
  • CLASSIC REEBOK STYLE - Whether you need a pair of white walking sneakers or womens tennis shoes, the Club C Double Revenge gives the woman on the go a vintage tennis inspired look that can be styled casual or dressy.

Product Description

The Club C Double Revenge women's sneakers take the Reebok classic style you love and adds a trendy 2-inch platform to give you extra height and on-trend fashion. Not your basic white leather sneakers, they have cool Reebok logos, tonal leather overlays, and a modern, chunky style. Perforated details make them breathable, and terry padding on the tongue and collar make them easy to wear all day. The high abrasion resistant rubber outsole ensures stability on the court, while the ultra-high cushioned midsole keeps you standing tall. Cute sneakers have never been so comfortable! If you're looking for the best pair of black or white platform tennis sneakers for women, you've found them. Available in women shoes size 5-11.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Stylish, comfortable, and worth it!
I absolutely love these sneakers! The cream and black color combination is exactly what I was hoping for and goes with pretty much my entire wardrobe. They have great traction, and they’re comfortable right out of the box. I have wide feet and normally wear an 8, but I ordered a 7.5 since that’s what I’ve been wearing in bowling shoes. They’re a little snug, so I probably could’ve stuck with my usual size 8, but I think they’ll stretch a bit with time. They’re not super lightweight (they remind me more of the weight of dunks), but they’re very comfortable. I’ve been wearing Converse for years, and they always leave my arches hurting, but I had no arch pain at all in these. Overall, I’m so happy with this purchase and can’t wait to wear them with all my outfits!

    I no longer need my custom orthotics because THESE SHOES ARE THE BEST!!!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 25, 2026
    Size: 7Color: Chalk/Core Black/Chalk
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Due to some pronation, my podiatrist fitted me for custom orthotics and gave me a list of recommended shoes to use with them. Since, I work in veterinary medicine and spend the majority of the day on my feet, I have needed really good shoes. On average, I walk about 3.5 miles during a shift. Trust me, I’ve tried them all with and without the custom orthotics and I’ve still had foot/ankle/knee pain. These shoes alone are the absolute best because they give great ankle/heel/arch support and the fit around the toes is perfect. They are sturdy, clean up easily, and I love the Reebok retro throwback. Over the last few years, I have repeatedly bought them and I hope they never stop production.

    I've been eyeing these shoes for quite a while, and finally caved as I was due for a new casual but smart looking tennis shoe. I love the platform and neutral color way of these, and I wear them confidently with jeans, trousers, and dresses alike.

    I purchased them in time for a week long trip to London where I wore them every single day. In fact, I didn't wear any of the other shoes I'd brought along with me as these were so versatile and comfortable.

    I wear a 10.5 so I sized up into an 11 as 10.5 is not offered. I think the 11 is a little too big, and if I don't take the time to lace them well, I notice that my heel will slip out a bit and cause some discomfort in my calf. However, I figured that out quickly and adjusted as necessary.

    In the end, I walked miles and miles around London and it's surrounding towns/villages and was very comfortable.

    Review: Reebok Club C Double Platform Sneakers

    I’ve been wearing the Reebok Club C Double Platform sneakers for a while now, and they’ve definitely become a go-to in my rotation. If you’re into classic silhouettes with a modern twist, these are a great choice.

    Style:

    The platform sole gives the traditional Club C design a fresh, elevated look—literally. It adds just the right amount of height without feeling over-the-top. They pair well with everything from joggers and jeans to dresses and skirts, which makes them super versatile for casual or slightly dressed-up looks.

    Comfort:

    Surprisingly comfy for a platform sneaker. The cushioning is solid, and the shoe feels stable and supportive, even after a long day on your feet. I wouldn’t call them ultra-lightweight, but they’re definitely not clunky either.

    Fit:

    They run true to size in my experience. The leather upper is snug at first but breaks in nicely after a few wears. If you have wider feet, you might want to consider going half a size up, especially if you wear thick socks.

    Quality:

    Reebok did a great job with the materials—good leather, clean stitching, and a durable sole that holds up well. They’re easy to clean too, which is a bonus if you like that fresh-out-the-box look.

    Final Verdict:

    If you’re looking for a sneaker that balances retro vibes with a modern edge, the Reebok Club C Double Platform is a solid pick. Stylish, comfortable, and versatile—definitely worth it.

About this Item

  • PLATFORM SOLE - It's the best selling Club C - elevated! We took trendy platform women's shoes and merged them into cute chunky sneakers that are great travel, work or casual walking shoes.
  • ALL DAY COMFORT - These aren't your average white sneakers for women. A hip platform is added to an iconic classic Reebok style to give you extra height and style. They have a durable rubber outsole and a padded terry tongue and collar.
  • DURABLE LEATHER UPPER - Grab the Club C Double womens sneakers when you need a pair of comfortable white tennis shoes - or just to make a fashion statement. Perforated details make them breathable, and tonal leather overlays elevate the design.
  • VERSATILE COLORS - Our iconic Club C Double sneaker collection goes the extra mile by offering women footwear options for everyday life. This is the shoe that goes with everything, and it's classic and trendy at the same time. Lace up closure.
  • CLASSIC REEBOK STYLE - Whether you need a pair of white walking sneakers or womens tennis shoes, the Club C Double Revenge gives the woman on the go a vintage tennis inspired look that can be styled casual or dressy.

Product Description

The Club C Double Revenge women's sneakers take the Reebok classic style you love and adds a trendy 2-inch platform to give you extra height and on-trend fashion. Not your basic white leather sneakers, they have cool Reebok logos, tonal leather overlays, and a modern, chunky style. Perforated details make them breathable, and terry padding on the tongue and collar make them easy to wear all day. The high abrasion resistant rubber outsole ensures stability on the court, while the ultra-high cushioned midsole keeps you standing tall. Cute sneakers have never been so comfortable! If you're looking for the best pair of black or white platform tennis sneakers for women, you've found them. Available in women shoes size 5-11.
